name: zomboid
title: Project Zomboid
reminders: Project Zomboid: players and servers find mods by the Mod ID line the page now ends with; check it shows on the item.
facts: A Workshop item is a folder holding workshop.txt, preview.png and Contents/mods/<mod id>/; Contents may hold only the folders buildings, creative and mods. The game's own uploader takes Contents as the item's content. Source: the game's uploader code, read on this PC (zombie/core/znet/SteamWorkshopItem.java), 23 Nov 2026.

Build 42 mods keep a mod.info (key=value lines: name, id, modversion, versionMin) in each game-version folder such as 42.15, beside common; a mod.info at the mod's top is Build 41's. The game reads the highest version folder no newer than itself; this file reads the highest.
The cover is preview.png at the item's top: a square PNG of 256 or 512 pixels and at most 1,024,000 bytes, checked by the game's uploader.
The game's uploader refuses .exe, .dll, .bat, .app, .dylib, .sh, .so and .zip files anywhere in the item.
It ends the description with Workshop ID and one Mod ID line per mod; players and dedicated servers use those lines to switch mods on.
It writes the item number into workshop.txt as id=. A repository of ours keeps the number in its catalogue; workshop.txt is the game's own staging folder's file.
Phobos repositories of this game hold one mod each, the repository's top being the mod folder; that is the layout here, which a catalogue can change.
